translations.web: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.
translations.bsb: So she left him, and after she had shut the door behind her and her sons, they kept bringing jars to her, and she kept pouring.
translations.kjv: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
translations.asv: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons; they brought the vessels to her, and she poured out.
